article.title: 真魔术
article.question: 为了让演员表演得逼真，在拍摄时给演员施加真实的痛苦、折磨，这种做法是否人道？

这当然是不道德的。

演技演技，看点就在于演员依靠代入去模拟的功夫。

看的就是这点功夫。

article.title: 输无可输
article.question: 教师如何激发学生主动学习的内驱力？
article.brief:
一句话，把横杆调高10cm。

学习如跳高，跳过65cm概率80%。

跳过70cm概率60%。

跳过75cm概率30%。

别的班跳65cm，因为害怕造成“挫败感”。

我们班跳75cm。

你看，有人跳过。

你别放弃，继续试。

你没跳过，不必沮丧。因为跳不过75cm本来
article.text:
一句话，把横杆调高10cm。
学习如跳高，跳过65cm概率80%。
跳过70cm概率60%。
跳过75cm概率30%。
别的班跳65cm，因为害怕造成“挫败感”。
我们班跳75cm。
你看，有人跳过。
你别放弃，继续试。
你没跳过，不必沮丧。因为跳不过75cm本来就不为失败。
跳得过是好样的。天生奇才，前30%。
跳了，差一点，还敢跳。
也是好样的——天生坚韧，意志前40%，才华也前40%。
跳了，差很多，还敢再跳。
你甚至比只差一点没跳过的更是好样的——意志前30%，才华并不重要。
你记住，人生在世，聪明才智不稀缺，坚韧不拔才稀缺。
你这种硬汉，就算不读大学，世界也埋没不了你。

跳，接着跳。这都是确定的知识。接受教训，改正错误，你必定全对，你必定胜利。
我们全班都必是前30%。
我们这里只有天才或者英雄，要么你是天才，要么你是英雄。
记住这个感觉，永远上调10cm。
上调10cm，消灭失败。
要么证明你是天才，
要么证明你是英雄。
如果是后者，你还赚了。

article.title: 必要但次要
article.question: 如何恰当地赞美孩子的进步成就而又不让孩子陷入自我满足而止步不前？
article.brief:
赞美、肯定子女，一定记住这句话：

赞美是必要的，但是赞美是次要的。

赞美是必要的，是因为人的行为是复杂的、多维的、多面向的，你其实不能笼统的赞美，例如“你真了不起”“你真厉害”，而是要确切的肯定——“那个阿姨摔倒时你伸手拉她那一下，做得好”“考试没考好，没花时间悲春伤秋，立刻
article.text:
赞美、肯定子女，一定记住这句话：
赞美是必要的，但是赞美是次要的。
赞美是必要的，是因为人的行为是复杂的、多维的、多面向的，你其实不能笼统的赞美，例如“你真了不起”“你真厉害”，而是要确切的肯定——“那个阿姨摔倒时你伸手拉她那一下，做得好”“考试没考好，没花时间悲春伤秋，立刻干劲十足查漏补缺，干得好”。
后者才是正确的肯定和赞美。
前者为什么不对？
因为前者无确切所指，子女极易认为这是指ta自己意会的“现在这件事”。而ta在定义“现在这件事”的时候，很可能追溯到会令你跌破眼镜的历史上游去。你可能说的是“（我没回家你知道自己做饭吃）真厉害”，但是ta可能认为你是在指“（我整个人都）真厉害”。
这不是在肯定事，而是在肯定整个人。
肯定整个人，的确在当时会让子女欣喜若狂，但在同时就埋下了一颗拆不掉而必然爆炸的逻辑炸弹——那么怎么过了三天ta就成了“烂泥扶不上墙”了？
如果你限定了行为定义，那么ta帮助老人就是好的、馋嘴偷钱就是糟糕的，这两者可以同时存在，不会引起ta的混乱，ta也不会觉得你反复无常、出尔反尔。
你不明确的限定评价的范围，只是泛泛的用“真厉害”“真了不起”“打总分”，子女的感受就变成了“我昨天整个的是好人，明天整个的是坏人，后天又变成了好人，后后天又整个的变成了坏人，后后后天则坏上加坏，后后后后天坏上加坏再加坏”。
接下来ta就一定会去争“总分”。
在ta眼里，一个人就是所有的行为分值加加减减之后的总数得出一个总分，一切都由这个总分决定。这样就能解释为什么昨天还是好厉害，今天就变成了没出息——那一定是因为我今天的扣分把昨天之前的前半生得到的总余额都扣光了，扣成负分了，所以我一下就从很厉害变成没出息了。
接下来的路就通向地狱了——因为你几乎必然会在某个时候出于“夸过了不用老夸，重点在纠正不足，以免失焦”的所谓“教育方法”的指引下，不断的、继续的指出问题。
一旦你在任何时候连续指出ta三四次、五六次问题，子女就会陷入极度恐慌——“我现在到底负了多少分了？”
你自认为是“就事论事”，但你的子女却已经觉得自己“罪大恶极”了。
你自认为“我既然没说那一点了，当然意味着那一点已经没问题了，你应该自动感到高兴”，而子女眼里的画面却是ta们很久都没把分数打回到正分了，次次都是负分之下又叠负分，ta们当然要绝望，当然要觉得“努力无用”了。
反正写作业也不可能把攒了-800分的评价回正，甚至作业写得不完美今晚可能再-5分。
那我为什么不干脆打游戏？一次-50好了。反正-800已经不可能拉正，-850又有什么区别？
不，有区别—— -850我可以玩一会儿游戏。
看明白没有？
永远肯定行为，永远批评行为，永远不要肯定整个人，不要否定整个人。
加限定，你就是在评价行为；不加限定，你就是在总体评价整个人。
这就一下回到了老问题——你有什么资格确定什么好行为加几分而什么坏行为应该扣几分？凭啥就是这么多分？
发现没有？只有神才能真正有效的做到“整体评价一个人”，人类根本就做不了这么复杂的计算工作。
你根本做不了，听明白了吗？
所以你一做就会错，就会自相矛盾。而这些胡作非为必然会释放出混乱的信号，尤其是会引导子女深陷错误的方法论。
尤其是还会诱导ta们也用这种“总分思维”去评价ta们自己看到的每一个人。
碰一辈子的壁。
而你为什么总是觉得不能赞美？
其实恰恰就是因为你用不带限定的赞美格式时，自己也觉得这是个“总体肯定”。
你害怕总体肯定会让子女收到错误信号，所以你很不愿意赞美子女——看到没有，“赞美子女”这个说法本身就是字面意义的“总体赞美一个人”。
一旦你学会永远加上具体的事务限定，你就可以抛开这个顾虑。
我肯定的是你自己做饭这件事，这跟我批评你作业写得马虎有什么关系？为什么我批评了你作业写得马虎，我就不应该肯定你自己做饭这件事了？
既然不再有“总体评价打击面过大”这种顾虑，你还有什么理由不把“赞美”——注意这是就事论事的肯定——视为必要的？
它当然是必要的——子女不但需要明确的信号知道自己应该改变什么，同样需要明确的信号知道自己应该坚持什么。
后者甚至要比前者更重要。
你信不信，你的肯定比游戏里刷出来的紫金装备重要得多。如果你这个能刷，ta们哪有心思去刷什么道具？

现在我们再谈第二条——赞美是次要的。
那就是要重视委任、合作、利润，高于重视赞美。
你逛街看到一个煎饼果子摊，摊主技艺娴熟，赏心悦目，摊的饼皮又薄又筋道，薄脆脂香清脆，包的馅料、调味都无懈可击，你会干嘛？
你是站在摊主面前赞美ta吗？
你是马上掏钱排队，准备下单。
如果没有“掏钱排队、准备下单”，你光围着摊主“赞美”，摊主什么感觉？
摊主觉得自己真的受了赞美吗？
摊主觉得自己受了戏耍。
因为订单、合作邀请、利润才是真正的赞美。
和这真正的赞美相比，口头的歌颂不值一钱。
看懂这是在说什么吗？
如果子女出现了值得赞美和肯定的表现，你首先要考虑的是怎么能构想一个“生意”，来对ta这个“优势业务”“下单”。
比如，ta表现出了对钱的敏感性，你可以委托ta去门口的小超市和菜场采购今晚的食材。如果质量不错，而且还有省下的钱，那么省下的一半可以纳入ta的零花钱账户。
ta表现出了一定的自制力，那么你可以扩大ta可以采购百货用品的商店名单。
要引导ta养成“如果我表现真的好，我为什么没有拿到新的订单”的习惯，而不是“如果我表现真的好，为什么你不夸我”的错误认识。
警惕那些口头夸赞，学会无视、穿透那些空口表扬，要把眼光落在业务现实上。
你夸我的煎饼果子举世无双，那么这样，我再给你打个八折，你来不来一套？
还是说你只是嘴上夸，要你来一套你却是舍不得的？
既然赞美，那么必然存在提出新offer的空间。要么赞美者提出，要么你可以发挥智慧，寻找新的合作可能。
不附带任何新的合作空间的赞美，有何实际意义？
这才是赞美是否真诚的要害——不在于对方会不会赌咒发誓“绝对真心”，而在于对方下没下单。
你也一样。
看到好表现，先考虑实质“下单”，让子女看到这个优良表现赢得的“订单”，挣到的信用和投资。
就像对表现好的员工，永远不要纯表扬——要么发奖金，要么加工资，要么提权限。
发了、加了、提了，再去加表扬。
哪怕你只奖一个橘子，对子女也要坚持“表扬必有好事”的原则。
可以有奖无夸，但基本杜绝有夸无奖。
久而久之，子女就会明白，走上社会少看什么狗屁“情绪价值”，而要看真金白银。
这就叫赞美是次要的。

永远记住——赞美是必要的，赞美是次要的。

{"root":{"children":[{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"赞美、肯定子女，一定记住这句话：","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"赞美是必要的，但是赞美是次要的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"赞美是必要的，是因为人的行为是复杂的、多维的、多面向的，你其实不能笼统的赞美，例如“你真了不起”“你真厉害”，而是要确切的肯定——“那个阿姨摔倒时你伸手拉她那一下，做得好”“考试没考好，没花时间悲春伤秋，立刻干劲十足查漏补缺，干得好”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"后者才是正确的肯定和赞美。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"前者为什么不对？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为前者无确切所指，子女极易认为这是指ta自己意会的“现在这件事”。而ta在定义“现在这件事”的时候，很可能追溯到会令你跌破眼镜的历史上游去。你可能说的是“（我没回家你知道自己做饭吃）真厉害”，但是ta可能认为你是在指“（我整个人都）真厉害”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这不是在肯定事，而是在肯定整个人。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"肯定整个人，的确在当时会让子女欣喜若狂，但在同时就埋下了一颗拆不掉而必然爆炸的逻辑炸弹——那么怎么过了三天ta就成了“烂泥扶不上墙”了？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果你限定了行为定义，那么ta帮助老人就是好的、馋嘴偷钱就是糟糕的，这两者可以同时存在，不会引起ta的混乱，ta也不会觉得你反复无常、出尔反尔。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你不明确的限定评价的范围，只是泛泛的用“真厉害”“真了不起”“打总分”，子女的感受就变成了“我昨天整个的是好人，明天整个的是坏人，后天又变成了好人，后后天又整个的变成了坏人，后后后天则坏上加坏，后后后后天坏上加坏再加坏”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"接下来ta就一定会去争“总分”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"在ta眼里，一个人就是所有的行为分值加加减减之后的总数得出一个总分，一切都由这个总分决定。这样就能解释为什么昨天还是好厉害，今天就变成了没出息——那一定是因为我今天的扣分把昨天之前的前半生得到的总余额都扣光了，扣成负分了，所以我一下就从很厉害变成没出息了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"接下来的路就通向地狱了——因为你几乎必然会在某个时候出于“夸过了不用老夸，重点在纠正不足，以免失焦”的所谓“教育方法”的指引下，不断的、继续的指出问题。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一旦你在任何时候连续指出ta三四次、五六次问题，子女就会陷入极度恐慌——“我现在到底负了多少分了？”","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你自认为是“就事论事”，但你的子女却已经觉得自己“罪大恶极”了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你自认为“我既然没说那一点了，当然意味着那一点已经没问题了，你应该自动感到高兴”，而子女眼里的画面却是ta们很久都没把分数打回到正分了，次次都是负分之下又叠负分，ta们当然要绝望，当然要觉得“努力无用”了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"反正写作业也不可能把攒了-800分的评价回正，甚至作业写得不完美今晚可能再-5分。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"那我为什么不干脆打游戏？一次-50好了。反正-800已经不可能拉正，-850又有什么区别？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不，有区别—— -850我可以玩一会儿游戏。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"看明白没有？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"永远肯定行为，永远批评行为，永远不要肯定整个人，不要否定整个人。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"加限定，你就是在评价行为；不加限定，你就是在总体评价整个人。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这就一下回到了老问题——你有什么资格确定什么好行为加几分而什么坏行为应该扣几分？凭啥就是这么多分？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"发现没有？只有神才能真正有效的做到“整体评价一个人”，人类根本就做不了这么复杂的计算工作。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你根本做不了，听明白了吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所以你一做就会错，就会自相矛盾。而这些胡作非为必然会释放出混乱的信号，尤其是会引导子女深陷错误的方法论。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"尤其是还会诱导ta们也用这种“总分思维”去评价ta们自己看到的每一个人。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"碰一辈子的壁。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"而你为什么总是觉得不能赞美？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"其实恰恰就是因为你用不带限定的赞美格式时，自己也觉得这是个“总体肯定”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你害怕总体肯定会让子女收到错误信号，所以你很不愿意赞美子女——看到没有，“赞美子女”这个说法本身就是字面意义的“总体赞美一个人”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一旦你学会永远加上具体的事务限定，你就可以抛开这个顾虑。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我肯定的是你自己做饭这件事，这跟我批评你作业写得马虎有什么关系？为什么我批评了你作业写得马虎，我就不应该肯定你自己做饭这件事了？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"既然不再有“总体评价打击面过大”这种顾虑，你还有什么理由不把“赞美”——注意这是就事论事的肯定——视为必要的？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"它当然是必要的——子女不但需要明确的信号知道自己应该改变什么，同样需要明确的信号知道自己应该坚持什么。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"后者甚至要比前者更重要。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你信不信，你的肯定比游戏里刷出来的紫金装备重要得多。如果你这个能刷，ta们哪有心思去刷什么道具？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"现在我们再谈第二条——赞美是次要的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"那就是要重视委任、合作、利润，高于重视赞美。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你逛街看到一个煎饼果子摊，摊主技艺娴熟，赏心悦目，摊的饼皮又薄又筋道，薄脆脂香清脆，包的馅料、调味都无懈可击，你会干嘛？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你是站在摊主面前赞美ta吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你是马上掏钱排队，准备下单","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果没有“掏钱排队、准备下单”，你光围着摊主“赞美”，摊主什么感觉？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"摊主觉得自己真的受了赞美吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"摊主觉得自己受了戏耍。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为订单、合作邀请、利润才是真正的赞美。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"和这真正的赞美相比，口头的歌颂不值一钱。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"看懂这是在说什么吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果子女出现了值得赞美和肯定的表现，你首先要考虑的是怎么能构想一个“生意”，来对ta这个“优势业务”“下单”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"比如，ta表现出了对钱的敏感性，你可以委托ta去门口的小超市和菜场采购今晚的食材。如果质量不错，而且还有省下的钱，那么省下的一半可以纳入ta的零花钱账户。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ta表现出了一定的自制力，那么你可以扩大ta可以采购百货用品的商店名单。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"要引导ta养成“如果我表现真的好，我为什么没有拿到新的订单”的习惯，而不是“如果我表现真的好，为什么你不夸我”的错误认识。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"警惕那些口头夸赞，学会无视、穿透那些空口表扬，要把眼光落在业务现实上。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你夸我的煎饼果子举世无双，那么这样，我再给你打个八折，你来不来一套？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"还是说你只是嘴上夸，要你来一套你却是舍不得的？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"既然赞美，那么必然存在提出新offer的空间。要么赞美者提出，要么你可以发挥智慧，寻找新的合作可能。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不附带任何新的合作空间的赞美，有何实际意义？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这才是赞美是否真诚的要害——不在于对方会不会赌咒发誓“绝对真心”，而在于对方下没下单。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你也一样。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"看到好表现，先考虑实质“下单”，让子女看到这个优良表现赢得的“订单”，挣到的信用和投资。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"就像对表现好的员工，永远不要纯表扬——要么发奖金，要么加工资，要么提权限。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"发了、加了、提了，再去加表扬。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"哪怕你只奖一个橘子，对子女也要坚持“表扬必有好事”的原则。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"可以有奖无夸，但基本杜绝有夸无奖。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"久而久之，子女就会明白，走上社会少看什么狗屁“情绪价值”，而要看真金白银。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这就叫赞美是次要的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"永远记住——赞美是必要的，赞美是次要的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

article.title: 悬决
article.question: 如何培养自己对事情悬而未决的耐受度？
article.brief:
这个问题啊，看着都令人心疼。

如果是小小的悬而未决，比如十块二十块这种的，那么也没什么好讲方法的，无非是自己慢慢适应。

既然这个悬而未决成为一个问题，自然是因为悬而未决的东西太大。

巨大的祸福悬而未决，一会儿想到最好的结果，极度兴奋；一会儿想到最坏的结果，极度恐慌。

article.text:
这个问题啊，看着都令人心疼。
如果是小小的悬而未决，比如十块二十块这种的，那么也没什么好讲方法的，无非是自己慢慢适应。
既然这个悬而未决成为一个问题，自然是因为悬而未决的东西太大。
巨大的祸福悬而未决，一会儿想到最好的结果，极度兴奋；一会儿想到最坏的结果，极度恐慌。
在天堂和地狱之间来回盘旋，被各种征兆、迹象刺激挑动。
这样的折磨，真不是谁都能受的。
任你生就铁打的心肠，几乎没有人能吃得下、睡得着。
说句笑话——减肥没有比这个更快的，一天瘦两斤不是梦。：目
最难的是你还要喜怒不形于色，因为你身上可能担着重大的干系，如果你一天到晚阴沉似水、郁郁寡欢，那你周围的人还会受到巨大的情绪冲击，引发连锁反应，让你更难承受这种巨大波动的消耗。
而维持喜怒不形于色本身又何尝不消耗能量呢？

迟早你会独当一面、支撑门户。
独当、支撑，听起来风光，其实就是“背后已无别人，你就是最后防线”的意思。
你总是要面对这种巨大的悬而未决的。

人的一生，如履薄冰。
何以解忧？
第一个，是要与坚强而有觉悟的人为伴。
每个人都要为自己的生命负起责任，除了自己生养的子女之外，与所有其他成年人的关系都要整理清楚，彼此都知道进退。
如果可以，万万不要与软弱依赖的人为伴。
谁离了谁，都有责任坚强不屈的继续生活，彼此之间不要有什么“没你我就不过了”这样的顾虑。
这样人面对的就是自己的因果，比起想到“我要是有事，谁谁谁要怎么办”的加倍折磨要好受得多。

第二个，就是说话做事总以爱为念。
随行随住，做好事，做成全人、造就人的事，做新建、修缮、治疗的事，而不要做破坏、伤害、离间的事。
这不仅仅是一个广结善缘、容易得到帮助的问题，还是一个关键时候心里安定、有所安慰的事。
无论如何，即使此时此刻我的生命即将终结，我在这世界上也留下了一些好的东西。
那美好的仗我已打过，而且战斗到了最后一刻，这本身已经是足够幸福的一生，其实只有丰富的获得，哪有所谓的损失？
只有“得着这么多”还是“得着更多”的区别，谈不上有什么“得着”和“没得着”的区别。
我已经得着了这么多，再为得不到更多而怨恨、哀伤，就是我自己被自己的贪婪所伤，罪有应得罢了，

而到了真正患得患失、一切都看天意的时候，你有某种理由相信天意对你会有所偏爱，那是身处这种境地所能有的最大的宽慰。
这不能完全免了你的折磨，但已经是莫大的安抚了。
记住这些，平时做起来，到时候你们会看到它有多重要的。

article.title: 狼狈
article.question: 孩子朋友想抄她作业，孩子在纠结应不应该借给朋友抄？如何才能既不伤害和朋友的感情又不害了朋友呢？
article.brief:
这样理解：

我直道而行，不为任何人曲枉，你才会因为是我的朋友而得到光耀。

如果我为了张三李四徇私枉法、偷鸡摸狗，那么你与我为友，你也会连带蒙羞受耻。

把张三李四换成你，结果又有何不同呢？

朋友和“狼狈为奸”的差别在哪里？

差别在于狼狈为奸者是彼此互助但却损害所有其他人的
article.text:
这样理解：
我直道而行，不为任何人曲枉，你才会因为是我的朋友而得到光耀。
如果我为了张三李四徇私枉法、偷鸡摸狗，那么你与我为友，你也会连带蒙羞受耻。
把张三李四换成你，结果又有何不同呢？
朋友和“狼狈为奸”的差别在哪里？
差别在于狼狈为奸者是彼此互助但却损害所有其他人的利益，与全世界为敌。
而朋友是彼此合作，共同有益于所有人，是全世界的朋友。
狼狈为奸，是为了一点小小得利失去整个世界，无论是狼是狈，一旦被视为一丘之貉，就会直接损害信用荣誉，社会资源就会对你主动关闭，导致你做任何事都信任成本极高。
这种损失是少考几个不及格、少挨几顿打换不回来的，是典型的因小失大。
换一个角度——你找我抄，我同意了，我们俩在别人眼里就都是王八蛋。
我没同意，那么不光我不是王八蛋，只要我作为反腐化的正直角色仍然是你的朋友，别人就会觉得你就算是个坏蛋也未见得全无可取之处。
我还能把你往上捞一捞。
你把我拉下去了，我们只有一起沉了。
是的，这么做会有很多指着拉头狼的小狈们嗷嗷叫，要威胁“你这样做将来会没朋友”。
ta们说对了，你是不会有ta们这种动不动就进去、净指着你来捞的“朋友”。
SO BE IT.

:""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这种损失是少考几个不及格、少挨几顿打换不回来的，是典型的因小失大。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"换一个角度——你找我抄，我同意了，我们俩在别人眼里就都是王八蛋。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我没同意，那么不光我不是王八蛋，只要我作为反腐化的正直角色仍然是你的朋友，别人就会觉得你就算是个坏蛋也未见得全无可取之处。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我还能把你往上捞一捞。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你把我拉下去了，我们只有一起沉了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"是的，这么做会有很多指着拉头狼的小狈们嗷嗷叫，要威胁“你这样做将来会没朋友”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ta们说对了，你是不会有ta们这种动不动就进去、净指着你来捞的“朋友”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"SO article.title: 再三大方
article.question: 大方的人该怎样做才不会让人觉得很好拿捏，被人占便宜？
article.brief:
举个最现实的例子，你一听就明白了。

张三找你帮忙，你耐心的听ta说完，然后问清楚细节，再跟ta探讨一下初步方案，最后张三期盼的看着你，问你能不能帮ta搞定。

你就说你考虑一下，明天答复ta。

第二天你告诉ta，“三十二万五，五成预付，三成交货付，两成一年后付”。

张三吓死
article.text:
举个最现实的例子，你一听就明白了。
张三找你帮忙，你耐心的听ta说完，然后问清楚细节，再跟ta探讨一下初步方案，最后张三期盼的看着你，问你能不能帮ta搞定。
你就说你考虑一下，明天答复ta。
第二天你告诉ta，“三十二万五，五成预付，三成交货付，两成一年后付”。
张三吓死，“怎么要这么贵吗？”
你告诉ta，“我问了一圈了，原本要三十五万才能请得动全部的人，我估计你压力大，有些环节我帮你顶了，收你个成本价，压到了三十二万五。”
ta说把ta剁馅卖了也搞不到这么多钱。
你告诉ta要么这样，可以预付少一点，但不包效果，要是效果不行那就大家认命，预付少的那一点就不要了。
再不行，“你要么这样，我给你介绍另一个高手，你跟ta谈，谈完我来帮你再砍砍价，以我的面子可以再压一压。”
再不行那就爱莫能助了。
你看你多大方，处处让步，一让再让，让到让无可让了。
这个价是真的，因为你很清楚张三出去问一圈也都是这个价差不多，那些人ta还不认识，谁知道会不会保质保量？

大方，首先体现在收取行业公允价格，给你优质服务。
退而求其次，体现在收取稍低价格，提供平均服务。
再退而求其次，体现在收取最低价格，提供可用服务。
连续退守三次，你就尽到了“大方”的全部义务。
而这三次退守，你都没有“被拿捏”可言——你都不但保了本，还有合理利润。
看出你的大方和这正确的大方的区别了吗？
错误的大方一开口就是不含利润的成本价。
退守一步就要么亏本、要么东西见不得人，而被对方一推挤，自己一揖让，结果必然是选择“东西见得人，自己吞亏损”。
而这样做下去的结果，是自己亏着本做出来的“可以见得人”的东西，对方极不满意。
因为对方期待的是“朋友级优等待遇”——极品级的服务。
你却不过面子，只好用已经亏本的成本，先把第一轮服务作废，再提供一轮“类极品”级服务给对方。
在第一轮服务作废时你已经血本无归，现在是免费付出第二轮成本去给对方极品服务，你收的是一次六折价，却已经亏了两倍多的本。
自己对比一下，孰优孰劣，孰是孰非。

article.title: 大胆
article.question: 年轻人是否应该勇敢试错？
article.brief:
其实这话并不对。

什么叫“勇敢试错”？

是“不管它多大风险，搞下去再说”吗？

那么这怎么解释那些身陷缅北的人呢？ta们不就是奉行这个逻辑，才去缅甸、柬埔寨“勇敢试错”的吗？

很显然，很多错后果是非常严重的，你没法对这个太“勇敢”。

你可能觉得“我只要小心不触犯法律就行了
article.text:
其实这话并不对。
什么叫“勇敢试错”？
是“不管它多大风险，搞下去再说”吗？
那么这怎么解释那些身陷缅北的人呢？ta们不就是奉行这个逻辑，才去缅甸、柬埔寨“勇敢试错”的吗？
很显然，很多错后果是非常严重的，你没法对这个太“勇敢”。
你可能觉得“我只要小心不触犯法律就行了”——但你相信吗？很多犯下大错的人也没想着要触犯法律，ta们只是单纯的相信“冒险家乐园机会多”，只是到了地方就由不得ta们罢了。
所以，无论如何，你们还是要尽最大的谨慎去做事，老老实实的了解和遵守法律，要靠真正的聪明才智和详细核实、精细推算选择的“明危实安”的题材去寻求大的利润。
比如你发现了一个钓石斑的特殊窍门，反复测试确实可靠，别人租船出海就经常扑空，当然是风险很高，但是你租船出海赚钱十之八九，这样就自然有超额利润了。
你一定是有所发明创造、有踏实努力换来的特殊优势，而且基于这个特殊优势，你仔细考量过，的确没有坑害任何人的正当利益，在这个基础前提上，去勇敢尝试。
上面这段话一定要仔仔细细看清楚，记明白。
这话什么意思？
1）在做实验验证发明创造方面，不要怕失败。这里要勇敢。
你算过了工程力学，留足了冗余，确实觉得自己没错了，你也做好支撑做好保险了，尤其是，你明确的知道你是在测试。在这个时候，因为系统复杂，你还是可能漏算、还是可能失败、亏损，这个时候，你可以大胆。
因为到这一步，你已经退无可退了。如果一件事安全到这个程度，对你仍然是过大的风险，你基本没有任何机会获得什么创见了。
你不能安全到这个程度，安全到这个程度，等于一个人在拒绝承担自己的历史责任。
是的，人类作为智慧生物，其实每个人身上都是有自己应分的历史责任的，你有责任要为你所在的社群冒一定量的未知风险。
社群首先奖励、保护的，也是那些勇于为社群承担这些未知风险的领头羊，所以这些人也在利益分配的最前列。
如果你拒绝一切未知风险，仅仅只冒已知风险，那么你当然无缘参与历史的创造了。
你要自我保护是可以理解的，但是不要保护到尽了最大的谦卑也没发现可预知而不可承受的风险后，仍然拒绝冒险。
你拒绝，等于你立志要在社群里当搭便车者了，开便车、推便车的人们是要惩罚你的。

第二，当你确信你的整个谋划里没有损害人的合法利益，而所有参与者你都规划了净收益（经过协商补偿后的净收益也算），那么你就可以认定你这是为爱冒险。
在满足了尽可能谦卑的前提下，为爱冒险，而不是为牟利冒险、为权势冒险，是可以大胆的。
因为人生的价值就是为爱冒险。

我已经尽了所有的谦卑去管理风险，从这个节点起，我已经没有理由再拒绝去爱。
若是到了这样的地步我还拒绝为爱冒风险，我生而为人是为了什么呢？
仅仅是为了经历一系列的生理刺激——哪怕是快感吗？
就像一把剑因为害怕缺口而不敢使用，那不是对剑的爱惜，而是对它的辜负和浪费。

我本为此而来，注定为此而死。
既已通过谦卑和谨慎最大限度的避免了对自我的浪费，在此基础上仍然出现的损害，我只能视为我人生使命的一部分。
我又有何可胆怯的呢？

抱着谦卑，为了爱，可以大胆试错。
自有天佑。

抱着傲慢，为了贪，任何大胆都是错。
赌对了也是错，赌对了甚至比赌错更错。
天厌之。

{"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"其实这话并不对。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"什么叫“勇敢试错”？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"是“不管它多大风险，搞下去再说”吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"那么这怎么解释那些身陷缅北的人呢？ta们不就是奉行这个逻辑，才去缅甸、柬埔寨“勇敢试错”的吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"很显然，很多错后果是非常严重的，你没法对这个太“勇敢”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你可能觉得“我只要小心不触犯法律就行了”——但你相信吗？很多犯下大错的人也没想着要触犯法律，ta们只是单纯的相信“冒险家乐园机会多”，只是到了地方就由不得ta们罢了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所以，无论如何，你们还是要尽最大的谨慎去做事，老老实实的了解和遵守法律，要靠真正的聪明才智和详细核实、精细推算选择的“明危实安”的题材去寻求大的利润。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"比如你发现了一个钓石斑的特殊窍门，反复测试确实可靠，别人租船出海就经常扑空，当然是风险很高，但是你租船出海赚钱十之八九，这样就自然有超额利润了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你一定是有所发明创造、有踏实努力换来的特殊优势，而且基于这个特殊优势，你仔细考量过，的确没有坑害任何人的正当利益，在这个基础前提上，去勇敢尝试。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"上面这段话一定要仔仔细细看清楚，记明白。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这话什么意思？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"1）在做实验验证发明创造方面，不要怕失败。这里要勇敢。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你算过了工程力学，留足了冗余，确实觉得自己没错了，你也做好支撑做好保险了，尤其是，你明确的知道你是在测试。在这个时候，因为系统复杂，你还是可能漏算、还是可能失败、亏损，这个时候，你可以大胆。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为到这一步，你已经退无可退了。","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果一件事安全到这个程度，对你仍然是过大的风险，你基本没有任何机会获得什么创见了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你不能安全到这个程度，安全到这个程度，等于一个人在拒绝承担自己的","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"历史责任。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"是的，人类作为智慧生物，其实每个人身上都是有自己应分的历史责任的，你有责任要为你所在的社群冒一定量的未知风险。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"社群首先奖励、保护的，也是那些勇于为社群承担这些未知风险的领头羊，所以这些人也在利益分配的最前列。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果你拒绝一切未知风险，仅仅只冒已知风险，那么你当然无缘参与历史的创造了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你要自我保护是可以理解的，但是不要保护到尽了最大的谦卑也没发现可预知而不可承受的风险后，仍然拒绝冒险。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你拒绝，等于你立志要在社群里当搭便车者了，开便车、推便车的人们是要惩罚你的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"第二，当你确信你的整个谋划里没有损害人的合法利益，而所有参与者你都规划了净收益（经过协商补偿后的净收益也算），那么你就可以认定你这是为爱冒险。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"在满足了尽可能谦卑的前提下，为爱冒险，而不是为牟利冒险、为权势冒险，是可以大胆的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为人生的价值就是为爱冒险。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我已经尽了所有的谦卑去管理风险，从这个节点起，我已经没有理由再拒绝去爱。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"若是到了这样的地步我还拒绝为爱冒风险，我生而为人是为了什么呢？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"仅仅是为了经历一系列的生理刺激——哪怕是快感吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"就像一把剑因为害怕缺口而不敢使用，那不是对剑的爱惜，而是对它的辜负和浪费。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我本为此而来，注定为此而死。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"既已通过谦卑和谨慎最大限度的避免了对自我的浪费，在此基础上仍然出现的损害，我只能视为我人生使命的一部分。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我又有何可胆怯的呢？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"抱着谦卑，为了爱，可以大胆试错。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"自有天佑。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"抱着傲慢，为了贪，任何大胆都是错。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"赌对了也是错，赌对了甚至比赌错更错。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"天厌之。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}
